Typed ONCE, here; the engine's selftests assert the code against it (tools/handoff-selftest.mjs) and tools/make-door-contract.py merges it into contracts/door.json with the DERIVED half (tools, REST paths). Change a shape here first, then the code, then the ratchet.

layout._doc: Where the shared lane lives (M-ADR-038). Standalone: <engine>/contracts. Monorepo: sharingu/contracts beside sharingu/engine. Every engine reader applies ONE rule.

initialize._doc: additive (B7a W11, Q60CCC574 — day-1 is one MCP URL): the first reply a client gets says what to do first
initialize.negotiation: the client's requested protocolVersion is echoed when listed in `protocols`, else the first (newest) is answered
initialize.instructions: the first-run guide: one line, then five numbered steps (1 `whoami` · 2 `missing` with project · 3 `formats` · 4 `preview` · 5 the write tool each item names: `file_contribution`, `save_knowledge`, `remove_knowledge`; a grade `submit_grade`, an answer `respond`), then one line naming a new team's four steps and the two fill skills (`fill-the-product-side`, `fill-the-gtm-side`: the plugin's skills, on the starter shelf through `broadcast` and `equip` for any other client; `weekly-review`) (src/mcp.js FOUR_STEPS_LINE), then one line for every session (`updates` first, `read` doc/start-here.md, `ask`, `wrap_up`); only the registry's tool names and the starter skills' slugs (src/mcp.js instructionsFor)
initialize.notifications: any notifications/* message is answered 202 with no body
initialize.batch: a JSON-RPC array is answered as an array of the replies (notifications carry none)

modern._doc: D3b: the stateless revision on the same endpoint. A request whose params._meta carries io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion is served by it (no initialize, no session); initialize and every other request keep the handshake revision's answers
modern.discover: server/discover answers before auth: {resultType: complete, supportedVersions, capabilities, instructions (initialize's own), ttlMs: 0, cacheScope: public, _meta: {io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo}}
modern.results: every result carries resultType (complete, or input_required for the confirm) and _meta io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo; tools/list, resources/list, resources/templates/list and resources/read carry ttlMs: 0, cacheScope: private; the bodies are the handshake revision's
modern.capabilities: read per request from _meta io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities: elicitation decides the confirm, the MCP Apps extension the card
modern.headers: MCP-Protocol-Version and Mcp-Method are required and must equal the body's version and method; Mcp-Name, when sent, must equal params.name (params.uri for resources/read), its =?base64?…?= form decoded; an Mcp-Session-Id is ignored and none is sent

errors.-32600: 400: a request with no id, or a batch holding a modern request

decisions.seam: src/decisions.js readDecisions · readQuestion · checkOptionAnswers · fileRound · exportRound; src/qnaire.js respondOptions → respondAnswers

list.query: ?status=open|in-force|superseded|countered&severity=<word>&area=<word>&sort=decided&limit=<n>&eval=1 (the MCP tool takes the same names as arguments); sort decided puts the latest ruling first (decidedAt, else the ruled row's last write; the open rows after) and limit (at most 500) cuts the rows after the counts, with more:true when it cut some; an unknown value is ignored, never an error
list.shape: { version, publishedAt, project (U-MCP D6: the project whose pack was read, or null), counts:{open, yours, inForce, live, pending, superseded, countered, blocker, high}, whoOwes:{you, code, elsewhere}, filter:{status, severity, area, eval, sort, limit}, more?, rows:[{qid, status, severity, area, question, options:[{what, tradeoff}], blocks, whoOwes, waitingOn, implStatus, supersededBy, updated, decidedBy, decidedAt, live:{answers:[…], inRound, counters:[…], ruled}}] }
list.counts: open = status open (blocker/high split among them) · yours = open rows owed by the caller, through src/decisions.js owedBy (equal to whoOwes.you by construction; the Open: yours metric) · inForce = decided + provisional (live/pending by implStatus) · superseded = superseded + moot · countered = rows with at least one live counter; computed over every visible row, the filter narrows rows only
list.whoOwes: counted over OPEN rows only, each through the ONE src/decisions.js owedBy(row, reader, live): the owner is the row's whoOwes, else its waitingOn · you = owed by the owner when the caller is the owner (for anyone else an owner row counts as elsewhere) · code = owed by code or build (a scan settles it) · elsewhere = any other named owner, or a waitingOn · a row answered through the link (a non-provisional answer filed on it) owes nothing
list.empty: no published pack -> 200 with rows [] and empty:'no_pack' (the EMPTY pattern on glass)
list.unreadable: the pack names a decisions file that is missing or not a list -> 502 {error:'unreadable'} (ERROR on glass)
list.live: the overlay read failed (not the daily quota, which answers the outage page) -> the published rows with live:'unreachable' (UNREACHABLE on glass: writes refused before the press)
list.html: a browser navigation (Sec-Fetch-Dest document, or Accept text/html first) gets the Decisions page; anything else JSON

card.shape: { version, decision:{…the full published row: qid, question, status, choice, label, updated, severity, area, why, options, blocks, whoOwes, waitingOn, implStatus, supersededBy}, live:{answers:[{by, at, option, provisional, tx}], inRound, counters:[{id, by, what, at, tempo}], ruled:{option, by, at, tx}|null}, counterCall }
card.counterCall: preview {items: [{contribution: {lane, kind: "counter", gapRefs: ["q/<qid>"], what, why}}]}, then file_contribution
card.inRound: true when the CALLER has an undecided kind round filing on this question
card.refusals: 404 not_found for a qid the pack lacks (or a malformed one) · 404 no_pack when nothing is published (EMPTY on glass) · 502 unreadable

respond.body: { qid, option:<int>, provisional?, eval?, project? } or { answers:[{ qid, option, provisional?, eval?, project? }, …] } (at most 50); a form carries qid · option · provisional · eval · next, or option_<qid> fields for several
respond.checks: every entry, before anything is written: free text (answer, a legacy item, an a_*/x_* field) or no integer option -> 422 option_required · a qid the pack lacks -> 404 unknown_qid · a question not open -> 409 not_open · an option index the row lacks -> 422 unknown_option; one refusal refuses the whole call and files nothing

filesAs.what: <qid> — <A|B|C>: <the pack's option text, never the body's>

respond.reply: { sent, contributions:[{item, tx, route, ruled?, ruleError?, error?}], picked:[{qid, option, letter, what, provisional}], note? }
respond.form: 302 to a same-origin next (default /question/<qid>) with filed=<n>, refused=<code> or txerror=<code>
respond.kept: the read_only_credential and cross_origin_session_write refusals stand before any of the above
respond.ruling: the caller is the owner and the pick is not provisional -> the filed answer is decided approve in the same request (contributions[].ruled:true); anyone else's answer, or a provisional one, waits undecided as before

round.add: { qid, eval?, project? } files lane leader · kind round · gapRefs q/<qid> (no table) -> { filed:true, qid, tx, route }; a qid the pack lacks -> 404 unknown_qid
round.export: { export:true, eval? } builds the caller's undecided answer and round filings into ONE rounds-format JSON [{key, qid, question, area, severity, why, options, choice, provisional}] (choice a/b/c or null), banks it through bankArtifact (group decisions, or eval) -> { artifact, href, count }; nothing in the round -> { artifact:null, href:null, count:0, note }
round.form: export -> 302 to the artifact; add -> 302 to a same-origin next (default /question/<qid>) with rounded=1 or refused=<code>

decisions.ruled: UI-B3, the filing->ruling link (ADR-079): when the question's owner picks a non-provisional option, POST /respond files the answer and decides it approve in the same request (decideTransmission, note 'ruled by option <L>'); the live overlay also returns answers decided approve, and live.ruled is the latest one {option, by, at, tx} (answers, inRound and counters stay undecided rows only). A ruled question owes nothing (owedBy), and Decisions, the QuestionCard and Home say 'ruled <L>, the publish catches up' until the next publish carries the ruling. No new table: the decided answer's gapRefs q/<qid> is the link; /contribution/:id links to /question/:qid.

home._doc: additive (UI-B3, Home): ONE composed read, src/home.js readHomeSummary, answered by GET /home/summary (JSON), the MCP `home` tool and GET /home (the page, rendered in-process from the same call). Owner rulings: Q935B7970, QF4CC7033 (superseded by sprint 3 B3, MCP.md §9 demand 11: Home leads with goals moved and who contributed, never a ranking of people), QD0A65555, QB953462F, QE9178667 + Q47C9CCD3, QB1623583, Q57988E56, Q45D29B33.
home.seam: src/home.js readHomeSummary(env, reader, q) -> the shape below; renderHome(summary, opts) draws it
home.shape: { project:{key, name}, org, asOf:{served, pack}, aim:{text, measure:{name, value, period, prior, priorPeriod, source}|null}, metrics:{needsYou:{total, decide, approve, grant}, inMotion:{total, withPerson, needsMore}, contributions:{total, byKind:[{kind, n}]}, shipped:{days, landed, reverted}|null}, needsYou:{rows:[{kind:'decide', qid, title, severity, options, choices:[{letter, what}] (the first four options, none picked: the one-pass fix 9), counters} | {kind:'approve'|'grant', id, title, lane, by, at, counters}], more, open, ruled:[{qid, title, option, word}], firstFive:{steps, done, total}|null}, goalsMoved:{period:'YYYY-MM', rows:[{goal, title, known, n, areas:{build, gtm, plans}, contributors:[{name, initials}]}], people}, meter:{done, total, pct, open, words, areas:[{area, label, applies, done, total, pct}]}|null, whoIsHere:{people:[{name, initials, role:'admin'|'seated'}], count, projects}, eval?, live?:'unreachable' }
home.reads: at most five D1 statements beyond the memoized auth, in ONE parallel wave (src/hotsql.js), then the checklist's meter once the open questions are read (src/checklist.js checklistFor: CHECKLIST_SQL, one statement; the questions and the owed set are this request's): S1 HOME_TX_AGG_SQL (the metrics), S2 HOME_OWNER_ROWS_SQL for the owner (the newest four approve and grant rows with their counter counts, on migrate-038's idx_transmission_parent) or HOME_FIRST5_SQL for anyone else, S3 DECISIONS_LIVE_SQL (via readDecisions), S4 HOME_GOALS_MOVED_SQL, S5 HOME_SEATS_SQL; the org's row (src/tenant.js, once a minute per isolate)
home.counts: decide = the pack rows src/decisions.js owedBy says are the caller's (== GET /decisions counts.yours, by construction) · approve / grant = the project's owner-route undecided filings of any kind but a question's four (answer, round, counter, critique) and grant / of kind grant, the owner's only (0 for anyone else) · inMotion (D2b: what has not landed, Build's own definition): withPerson = route owner, undecided, any age; needsMore = route incomplete, undecided, filed in the last seven days; a contribution filed straight through has landed and is not in motion · contributions = every work contribution of the project, all time, each kind with its count (a record, kind knowledge or grade, and the list's own presses are never one) · shipped = {days, landed}: what landed in the last seven days (the week's own read, src/week.js), else null
home.rows: at most four: decide rows by severity (blocker, high, normal), then approve, then grant; more = needsYou total minus the rows drawn; open = the /decisions open count (the All N open link); the counters on an approve or grant row are its STANDING counters (src/hotsql.js STANDING_COUNTER, UI-B4a: a ruled counter no longer counts)
home.project: the request's workspace, else the org's one declared project, else none (the rows no project stamps); the page shows the project's NAME, never its key
home.empty: every region draws its own EMPTY sentence: aim 'No measure published for this aim yet.' (no aim.measure) or 'No aim is published for this project yet.'; needs-you (a seat with no filing yet: the first-five steps are its next action; never the owner's); goals-moved 'No goal moved this month.'; who-is-here 'Nobody is seated on this project yet.'; the Shipped card until the brain exports it
home.live: a failed D1 statement (not the daily quota, which answers the outage page) -> live:'unreachable': the regions it fed read null/EMPTY and the page shows UNREACHABLE (writes refused before the press)
home.buttons: decide row: choose-option -> POST /respond {qid, option:0, next:/home}; see-options -> GET /question/:qid · approve row: approve -> POST /contribution/:id/decide {verdict:approve, next:/home}; see-diff -> GET /contribution/:id · grant row: grant-once -> the same door {verdict:approve, note:'granted once'}; not-yet -> {verdict:needs-work, note:'not yet'}, terminal (no snooze: the agent re-files with parent) · counters: client-side, the count from this read and the exact MCP call (by gapRefs q/<qid> on a decide row, by parent on an approve or grant row) · all-open -> /decisions
home.grant: a grant is a filing: a contribution item {lane:'leader', kind:'grant', what, why, touches} through preview, then file_contribution; the router sends kind grant to the owner with reason asks-a-grant (src/transmission.js, at the route step, so a code, design or gtm grant still meets its screen and proof gates first)
home.goalsMoved: this project, this calendar month (UTC): the goals that filings moved (route auto or decided approve, goalRef set), each with how far (n: its contributions this month, and by area: src/lanes.js AREA_OF_LANE) and its contributors by name, in name order: no rank, no per-person count; the suites' seats only with eval; the most-moved goal first
home.meter: the project's checklist meter (src/checklist.js), overall and per area it has; null when the read has no project or failed

build._doc: additive (UI-B4b, Build): ONE read, src/build.js readBuild, answered by GET /build (JSON to a script, the page rendered in-process from the same call to a browser) and the MCP `build` tool. Owner rulings: Q0B546903 (seated readers, scoped to the workspace), QD0A65555 (a filing's tempo, the counters plus the MCP call), QC8B94276 + QB953462F, QEFC716D5 (rank), Q893B08A5 + Q4F5323A0 (the Queue and Files views retired), QE9178667 + Q47C9CCD3.
build.seam: src/build.js readBuild(env, reader, q) -> the shape below; renderBuild(read, opts) draws it
build.query: ?kind=<kind> (only that kind's rows, in the statement) · ?sort=ranked|newest|goal (default ranked) · ?eval=1 (the suites' rows); the tool takes the same names as arguments; an unknown value is ignored, never an error
build.shape: { project:{key, name}, asOf:{served, pack}, counts:{contributions, inMotion, onCanvasWeek, byKind:{<kind>: n}, records}, filter:{kind, sort}, rows:[{id, title, chip, verdict, tempo, kind, lane, by, via, goal:{ref, title}|null, counters, rank, at, happenedAt, decidedAt, eval?}], more, tempo:[{id, title, tempo, ago}], finishLine:{done, total, gating, deferred}|null, eval?, live?:'unreachable' }
build.reads: at most TWO D1 statements beyond the memoized auth and owner lookup, in ONE parallel wave (src/hotsql.js): B1 BUILD_ROWS_SQL (the newest 51 rows on idx_transmission_project, each row's standing-counter count and latest rank press as subqueries on idx_transmission_parent) and B2 BUILD_AGG_SQL (the counts, grouped by kind); the org's row (src/tenant.js, once a minute per isolate)
build.scope: the project is Home's (the request's workspace, else the org's one declared project); the owner reads the whole project, anyone else only while seated on it (or when the org has no project axis): a non-owner with no seat reads EMPTY, never another project's rows. sharingu's own mind/* rows and the rank filings themselves are never rows
build.rows: the newest 50 filings (more = how many older ones the counts hold beyond them); chip = ONE design-law state chip: with a person -> OPEN, in -> REVIEW, needs more -> gap, approved or on the canvas -> LANDED, rejected or sent back -> REVIEW with its verdict word; tempo = src/tempo.js tempoOf; counters = the STANDING counters filed on it by parent (the one standingCounter definition); rank = the latest rank press (ISO) or null
build.sort: ranked = rows with a rank press first, the newest press first, then the newest work; newest = when the work happened (happenedAt, else when it was filed); goal = grouped by goal (titled, then untitled refs, then no goal), newest work first inside a group. The order covers the newest 50 filings (the read's own rows, by when they were filed); at = when the row was filed, happenedAt = when the work happened (migrate-051) or null
build.counts: contributions = every work contribution of the project (never a record) · inMotion = what has not landed: with a person (route owner, undecided, any age) or needing more (filed in the last seven days), Home's definition · onCanvasWeek = landed and drawn in the last seven days, before the served publish · byKind = every filing of each kind present (All = their sum)
build.tempo: the three rows that moved last (decided, else filed) in the last seven days: {id, title, tempo, ago}; EMPTY 'Nothing moved this week.'

build.empty: no filing: 'Nothing filed on <project> yet. Work is filed from your own Claude through the MCP door.'
build.unreachable: a failed D1 wave (not a quota): rows [], counts null, live:'unreachable'; the page shows the UNREACHABLE banner and the rank press is refused before it is made

rank.seam: src/build.js fileRank(env, reader, {id, eval, via}) -> core.js fileTransmission
rank.body: {id} as JSON or a form (a form may carry next, same-origin, and eval); the tool takes {id, eval?}
rank.files: ONE filing: lane leader, kind rank, parent <id>, the ranked filing's project, what 'Ranked first on Build: <title>', why the rank rule; eval when asked or when the ranked filing is a suite row

counter._doc: additive (UI-B4a): kind "counter" in the router. A counter is a filing (QC8B94276): no table, no POST /counter. It names a FILING by parent a QUESTION by gapRefs q/<qid> (QB953462F) and a GOAL node by gapRefs goal/<id> (UI-B6a, Q48115AD1), is graded before the lane gates (src/transmission.js gradeAndRoute: what, why and a target; touches optional; no screen, proof or component gate), always routes to the owner and stands until it is ruled. ONE standing-counter definition, src/hotsql.js STANDING_COUNTER, is read by Decisions, the QuestionCard, Home's approve and grant rows and the filing page, so they show the same number.
counter.reasonRule: counters-a-filing when parent is set, counters-a-question when a gapRef is q/<qid>, counters-a-goal when a gapRef is goal/<id>, each that applies; for kind counter the question reason replaces answers-a-question. A gapRef of none of the three forms (screen:041, goals/x) is no target
counter.incomplete: no target: route incomplete, grade.missing ['parent'], binding false; the reply's example carries parent and the drawn call, its note names all three target forms (parent, gapRefs q/<qid>, gapRefs goal/<id>)
counter.parentCheck: a filing naming parent (any kind) needs that filing to exist in the filer's project (a null project matches a null project; the owner may name any), else 422 unknown_parent and nothing is filed; a batch with one unknown parent refuses the whole batch (every result carries unknown_parent, item = the first offending index)
counter.standing: kind IN ('counter','critique') AND decision IS NULL
counter.call: preview {items: [{contribution: {lane, kind: "counter", parent: "<id>", what, why}}]}, then file_contribution
counter.callQuestion: preview {items: [{contribution: {lane, kind: "counter", gapRefs: ["q/<qid>"], what, why}}]}, then file_contribution
counter.callGoal: preview {items: [{contribution: {lane, kind: "counter", gapRefs: ["goal/<id>"], what, why}}]}, then file_contribution
counter.page: GET /contribution/:id (a browser): the counters region lists every counter on the filing by parent, headed "N standing · M ruled", each linking to its own page, then the exact call with the id filled in; EMPTY: "No counters on this filing." Two D1 statements in total: the row (core.js transmissionOneFor) and src/hotsql.js FILING_COUNTERS_SQL

mapPlane._doc: additive (UI-B8a, QFAEA20A3; the model planes UI-B8b): ONE plane of the map. A plane that describes the door you are calling reads the worker's OWN registries in-process (api from CAPABILITIES, mcp from MCP_TOOLS), never the project's model, so it equals this file at the deployed sha and is the same for every project. A plane that describes THE MODEL reads the project's model live from D1 (src/knowledge/canvas.js: arch from its architecture node, data from its table nodes and their relations); what the worker knows about itself stays in-process (the seam's counts, the reader's seats and the org's active count; the org worker's name is the org's, from its own row). Flows and deps are UI-B9's. write.merge: an upsert merges: a field present in data overwrites, an absent one keeps its stored value, and the merged row is what is checked; a new row needs its required fields; a remove needs only the key fields, and removing what is not there changes nothing
write.rules: per op, the kind's field rules (src/knowledge/schema.js KINDS: the brain kit's goal tree, measure, question, gap, flow and GTM template rules); across the batch's end state: exactly one root goal, every parent a goal, no cycle, a removed goal leaves no child; an open question has 2 or more options and no choice, a ruled one with options names its choice or carries a label; an edge's two nodes exist; a card's refs (at most 12, card/<kind>/<id>) are cards of the same project the writer may read, never the card itself (missing_card names the near matches); a node's ownedBy (its data.ownedBy, a diagram part's ownedBy) names an active project of the org the writer may read, never the one written (unknown_project lists the keys they may name; a key the stored node already named is not checked again). A question's options ride inline (data.options: [{what, tradeoff?}], at most 26) and replace the stored ones when sent; removing a question removes its options, removing a node its edges.

projectScope._doc: additive (U-MCP, batch:mcp-project-scope; owner ruling Q0D506BBC, Forks 1-4, 2026-09-29; Q93B3F368 project, not workspace; ADR-100; M-ADR-027): every project-scoped read at every door reads the project the caller NAMES, checked against their seats, per call — generic for every org, no per-project branch (a project differs only by its data), no use_project tool, no migration, no write. ONE helper, src/project.js resolveProject(person, want, seats, env), is called by the workspace seam (src/index.js routeRequest: the GET twins' ?project=), src/mcp.js callTool (every MCP_TOOLS row flagged project:true — tools[].project in door.json, derived) and src/mcp.js resources/read (?project= on a brain:// URI). The seats are read once per request (src/core.js seatsOnce, D9).
projectScope.rule: `project` (an MCP argument on the tools, ?project=<key> on a GET twin or a brain:// resource) names one of the caller's seats; the owner may name any ACTIVE project (doorProject's own validation). Anything else is refused project_forbidden { error, project, seats, note, example? } and nothing is read. Naming a project NEVER writes the session stamp (POST /project does). The tool's `project` description is src/core.js READ_PROJECT_RULE on a read and PROJECT_RULE on a write.
projectScope.default: no `project`: the caller's active project (the session stamp, or a single seat: whoami's activeProject), else the FIRST project in the org's order (the projects' keys, sorted) the caller may read (a seat; the owner: an active one), then the caller's other seats — never a project the caller holds no seat on; a caller seated nowhere who is not the owner reads the org root (project null). A defaulted read that could have been scoped otherwise carries projectNote ("Add `project`: one of [...]"), built by the helper from the projects the caller may read (their seats; the owner: the active projects, so a seatless owner's default read names them too). whoami, initialize and start-here are unchanged; whoami's activeProject stays null for a multi-seat key.
projectScope.writes: the writes whose validation reads the project's set (respond, rule_question, submit_grade, publish_version, restore_version, and POST /round) validate against the project they name; the person is re-stamped for the call only when the project is NAMED or is their real active one, so a multi-seat write with no `project` still answers project_required (a defaulted read scope never files a write)
projectScope.answer: the answer names the project it read: updates carries project {key, name}; every other scoped JSON read that carried `project` keeps it
projectScope.resourceRefusal: resources/read answers JSON-RPC error -32003 with the message 'project_forbidden: <note>'; resources/list and resources/templates/list descriptions say 'Add ?project=<key>' (additive)
projectScope.twinRefusal: a GET twin naming a project the caller may not read answers 403 JSON { error:'project_forbidden', project, seats, note, example? }
projectScope.restWrite: U-MCP-tail-c N2 (QE6B9CEBA): POST /grade (submit_grade's REST twin) scopes by its JSON body `project` through the SAME helper as the tool (src/mcp.js projectCallScope): a named project the caller may not read answers 403 JSON { error:'project_forbidden', project, seats, note, example? } and nothing is filed or counted; a readable named project grades on its re-scoped env; no `project` keeps the seam's scope. GET /updates calls the updates tool itself (src/mcp.js callTool), so its scope IS the tool's.
projectScope.input: U-MCP-tail-b D3 (QE6B9CEBA, Q952CAE10): src/core.js projectArg(v) is the ONE parse of a `project` argument at every door (resolveProject, doorProject, ask, POST /broadcast/equip, the wrap-up, the answer entries, round): undefined, null and "" are none; a string is trimmed and lower-cased; any other shape (object, array, number, boolean) is refused project_forbidden (not-allowed; nothing read or filed; `seats` listed; note "`project` is one project key, a string") — never coerced, never a 500
projectScope.liveStamp: U-MCP-tail-b D4: the session stamp defaults a read (resolveProject), fills an unnamed write (doorProject) and is the activeProject of whoami and updates ONLY while live (src/core.js liveStampOf: one of the caller's seats, or for the owner an ACTIVE project); an owner's stamp on an archived project is none — whoami, initialize and start-here bytes are unchanged for every live stamp
projectScope.answerProject: U-MCP-tail-b D5: one project per answer call (respond, round; REST and MCP): the entries' `project` and the call's top-level `project` name one project (or none), else project_forbidden with nothing filed; a named project goes through resolveProject and the qid is validated against THAT project's pack, the one the answer is stamped into
projectScope.packProject: U-MCP-tail-b D6 (healed: the adversarial review's finding 2): the project of read, changes and submit_grade's check_results row is the request's scope (the request's scope, src/project.js: the scope, or a single-project org's one project, else null — the org level); nothing a client sends besides `project` names the project, so no claim moves a grade or a read. With no project (a caller seated nowhere in a multi-project org) submit_grade is refused project_required and nothing is filed (check_results.project is a project key); a grade whose filing stamp differs from the project it reads is refused project_required naming it (example), so the grade row and its filing always agree
projectScope.readProject: U-MCP-tail-b D7: the brief of your own items (briefCountFor: every page's badge; updates' `yours` and GET /updates, in doors already) and GET /missing's ledger half read the request's scope (src/project.js projectOf / projectScopeOf, the rule home.js and the pack door read by), never the raw session stamp: a scope filters `project = ?`; an org with ONE active project filters `project = ?` on it (the project every door's default reads, so a tool equals its twin); a multi-project org's null scope (seated nowhere, not the owner) filters `project IS NULL`, never org-wide; an org with no active project row has no filter (byte-identical)
projectScope.multiProject: U-MCP-tail-b heal (the adversarial review's finding 1): ONE rule decides "multi-project" for the workspace seam (whether a request is scoped) and for projectScopeOf (a null scope's filter) and a seatless write's stamp (doorProject): src/core.js orgProjectsOnce — the D1 ACTIVE projects, through one memo (a minute per isolate, keyed by the D1 binding, pinned per request; /control's project writes drop it), so the seam and the reads never disagree

projectScope.switcherChip: U-TOPBAR: the top bar's project chip names the project the page read (the seam's resolveProject scope: named ?project=, the live stamp, or a member's single-seat/first-readable default); the owner's unnamed default is the org rollup and reads 'All projects'; ?project= never writes the stamp; Map · Arch hands the shell its arch plane's org-worker `projects` (U-MCP-tail-c N0), so its chip reads what every other page reads
